work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief LXXXV grants the winter cappa and summer mozzetta to the supernumerary canons of Ancona; LF14864 → LF14874 across LXXXIV’s provenance LF14867, own provenance LF14870 and page number 102 LF14873; complete 16 March 1836 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF14849–14849; the source closing at LF14931–14934 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima sexta martii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo sexto, pontificatus Nostri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
